dogecoin.text: There's no shortage of senior politicians and civil servants who've been dazzled over the years by financiers. I think that probably diminishes if you remember attending a lot of parties where the guys in finance were telling you about sinking their savings into $DOGE
The good news about the Dogecoin dip is that you're paying a much lower price for the same stream of income that you were yesterday.

Which is actually great - from my perspective you spend a lot less time entertaining the views of the nutters on markets and macro issues because they're all busy doing technical analysis of the resistance levels in the Litecoin/Dogecoin exchange rate.
